integrity: The mathematical claim is supported by a direct proof and a separately replayable finite verifier; overlap claims are limited to sources actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The theorem does not determine the exact value for complete bipartite graphs whose smaller shore has size at least four.

The 2011 framework paper was compared through indexed metadata and abstract rather than a complete line-by-line full-text inspection; an unindexed equivalent formulation is therefore a residual originality risk.
Finite computation is used only as a stress test and not as proof of the infinite statement.
title: Three-color threshold for generalized total colorings of complete bipartite graphs
